parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of mask propagation in NDDataRef arithmetic operations, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of mask handling when one operand has a mask and the other does not. This may introduce unexpected behavior in other parts of the code that rely on the previous behavior.
